about: The rights register. Every source Mess writes from, links to or has decided not to use, with its licence, whether a model may read it, the credit it needs and when its terms were last read. tools/check-rights.mjs is the gate: it fails if any statement cites a source this file does not allow. Claude is not a lawyer; an entry records what the source's own terms say.

fields.use: write = a model may read it and statements may cite it. link = Mess may link to it and nothing more. frozen = statements were made from it before 20 Nov 2026; nothing may be added or reworded until its owner says yes in writing (see claude/permission-emails.md).
fields.ai_input: yes, no, ask (the owner says to ask first) or per-item (the licence is on each article and is recorded with each saved copy). This is about a model reading the text to write or check a statement, not about training.
fields.licence: An SPDX identifier where there is one.
fields.credit: The credit line a page built from this source must carry.
fields.checked: The date the terms were last read. checked_how says by whom or what. Re-read every 3 months: the gate warns after 92 days.
fields.labels: Patterns matched against a statement's source label. hosts are matched against its link.

sources.name: NHS website (Health A to Z, Medicines A to Z)
sources.credit: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.checked_how: Terms page read by script on 21 Nov 2026: content is released under the OGL except where specified; a search of the page for AI, machine learning and automated use found nothing.
sources.notes: Text Mess has changed must not be credited to the NHS or name the NHS as its source, and must not suggest NHS approval. Some content is outside the standard terms (listed on the NHS site). Written for patients, so light on management detail.

sources.name: Open-access journal articles through Europe PMC
sources.credit: Credit each article: authors, title, journal, year, DOI and its licence, and say that Mess has reworded it.
sources.checked_how: Each article's own licence is read from its full text when it is saved (tools/fetch-open.mjs) and must be one of open_licences. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND and anything else are refused.
sources.notes: CC BY covers the authors' own text. Where an article reports another body's guidance (NICE, SIGN, BTS, GOLD, BNF), those sentences are set aside when it is saved and never reach a model. Cureus is ruled out (it bans AI use). Reviews and society statements under 5 years old only.
